name: chrisrohn-new-music-site
description: The chrisrohn.com client (site/src) with its build, lint, type check, browser smoke test and installable-app screenshots

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server -d dist 8000
scripts.walkthrough: npm run build && node docs/walkthrough/capture.mjs docs/walkthrough/shots && python3 docs/walkthrough/pdf.py docs/walkthrough/shots docs/youtube-api-walkthrough.pdf
